description: Save the active document. With filePath, save it as an Illustrator (.ai) or Illustrator EPS (.eps) file there; the document then refers to that file. Can also save each artboard to its own file

artboards.description: With separateArtboards: the artboards to save, 1-based: "1", "1-3,5". Default all

cmykPostScript.description: .eps: include CMYK PostScript in RGB files. Default true

compatibility.description: Illustrator version to save for: 24 = Illustrator 2020 and later (default), 17 = CC, 16 = CS6

compatibleGradientPrinting.description: .eps: rasterise gradients and meshes for older PostScript printers. Default false

embedIccProfile.description: .ai: embed the document's colour profile. Default true

filePath.description: Absolute .ai or .eps path. Omit to save in place

fontSubsetThreshold.description: .ai: subset embedded fonts when less than this percent of their characters is used. Default 100

overprint.description: .eps: keep or discard overprints. Default preserve

pdfCompatible.description: .ai: embed a PDF-compatible copy so other apps can preview it. Default true. False gives a much smaller native file

separateArtboards.description: Also save each artboard to its own file, named after the artboard. Default false

transparency.description: Saving for Illustrator 8 or 3 only, which have no transparency: preserve_paths (discard transparency) or preserve_appearance (flatten it)

name: save_document
title: Save Document
